title: How It Felt, and What I Hope For
label: ch:ja-how-it-felt-and-what-i-hope-for
canDo: I can say how something felt (tanoshikatta desu; omoshirokunakatta desu), what I want to become (isha ni naritai desu), what I have done before (itta koto ga arimasu), and that I never have until now (imamade ichido mo).

payoff.summary: Complete JA-R258-how-it-felt: say how a trip felt, what you hope to become and what you have done before.
